releaseNotes.en: Memory now keeps only what you saved on purpose, and can bring over what Claude Code, Codex, Hermes, OpenClaw, Gemini CLI, Qwen Code, Trae or Goose already remembers about you.
releaseNotes.zh-hans: 记忆现在只收你主动存的东西；还能把 Claude Code、Codex、Hermes、OpenClaw、Gemini CLI、Qwen Code、Trae、Goose 记住的东西一次带过来。
